findings.question: Compatible delivery contracts without global host loosening
findings.observed: Compiled function yh clones original headers before per-attempt filter invocation, selects URI index within request.attempt, selects scheme plugin, scopes common token by selected URI host, and uses an abortable bounded backoff. Recoverable retry increments request.attempt; critical/aborted paths stop.
findings.inferenceForFotty: Keep each exact selected delivery's reviewed URL, headers and grant together. Re-derive headers from the original reviewed source contract after a redirect/alternate URI; never inherit first-origin headers or admission from another source. Preserve current exact-host/path/TLS/public-IP rules rather than enabling general Shaka-like arbitrary URI dispatch.
findings.currentRepairMapping: CNC adapter reviewed HLS contract and source-local endpoint validation; StreamSession.renewingDelivery drops obsolete profiles. This does not justify broad host, HTTP, token or DRM exceptions.

findings.question: Freshness and conflicting metadata authority
findings.observed: Release HLS parser evicts relative to the first segment still advertised by the playlist and clamps live edge to advertised segments. EXT-X-ENDLIST is tracked per active playlist before presentation converts to VOD.
findings.inferenceForFotty: Do not promote wall-clock kickoff, a source LIVE label, a successful manifest fetch or a progressing player clock into sports identity/current-status authority. Keep official fixture state and exact provider event binding separate from delivery readiness, metadata TTL and actual transport expiry. An expired 90-second metadata receipt alone does not revoke an otherwise unexpired selected stream.
findings.currentRepairMapping: Existing exact date/team/squad/competition binding and source refresh conflict checks remain required. This player library supplies no football/cricket schedule authority; no claim that it prevents wrong live-sports listings.

findings.question: Single-player fullscreen/PiP ownership
findings.observed: Compiled q.hd / SR / kS presentation paths request PiP/fullscreen on the same a.u media element, exit the incompatible presentation first, and dispatch presentation errors; selected path does not call load or replace media source. Published source likewise uses this.localVideo_.
findings.inferenceForFotty: Keep one selected playback attempt and AVPlayerItem while changing presentation. Fullscreen/PiP callbacks must be owner-correlated, and presentation failures must not silently restart source discovery or consume transport retry budget.
findings.currentRepairMapping: Preserve NativeFullscreenSession/player/item ownership and source UUID. Validate with physical iPad same-item receipts; web API static evidence is not native PiP proof.

followupProxyReview.scope: Read-only focused audit of the observed CS HLS overlap complaint; no relay/policy/test changes or new runtime work.

followupProxyReview.finding: No confirmed local URI-registration defect. Equal absolute URLs keep route identity; reviewed equivalent wrappers keep their first immutable destination; rewrite is serialized and atomic; sequence/timing tags remain intact; caching is disabled. Only LRU eviction then re-registration changes a former route; no permitted receipt established that 4096-entry threshold was reached.
